_comment: Claudle v2. Each entry is {prompt, aiOutput}. 'prompt' is the secret 5-word instruction (the answer players guess). 'aiOutput' is what the AI said in response, shown to players as the clue. 'dated' entries are shown on that exact calendar date; 'rotation' entries fill every other date, picked deterministically by day-of-year so everyone sees the same puzzle on a given day. Extend via scripts/generate-day.js once ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is available.
